# Agent Failure-Mode Taxonomy (gzkit)

> **Rule version:** `0.8.1` — the Opus-tier source re-sourced to the Claude Opus 5.5 System Card (GHI #1089); patterns unchanged (nine). Prior version history lifted to [Rule Version History](../../docs/governance/rule-version-history.md#agent-failure-modesmd).

Patterns are maintained against the **current** frontier system cards — the registry-rotated set in `data/frontier_model_cards.json` (chore: `frontier-model-card-currency`), presently the Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card (§§ 2.3.3, 6.2.1, 6.4.2–6.4.5, 6.6.1), the Claude Opus 5.5 System Card (§§ 6.3.1, 6.4.1, 6.4.3–6.4.5, 6.5.1), and the GPT-5.6 System Card (§§ 7.1–7.4, 9.1.3.6, 9.2.2) — and against repo-observed defects cited in the worked examples. Origin lineage lives in [Rule Version History](../../docs/governance/rule-version-history.md#agent-failure-modesmd), never in this rule. Cite by name when reviewing, filing defects, or extending the scorecard to route directly to the backstop. **Loading posture:** advisory vocabulary, not a mechanical gate — the defenses named in the Backstop column are the shared enforcement.

| Pattern | Definition | Backstop |
|---------|-----------|----------|
| **Safeguard circumvention** | Works around a guardrail instead of producing the evidence it asks for | Behavior Rules — the ledger-and-hooks rule; ARB receipts; § Gate Covenant (Gate 5 is universal) |
| **Reckless action** | Hard-to-reverse action without confirming authorization for this scope | DO IT RIGHT #1 (fix the class, not the instance); brief-boundary anti-pattern |
| **Fabrication** | Synthesized claim/receipt/attestation not observed from primary source | ARB receipt discipline; § Attestation (operator words verbatim, then evidence) |
| **Skipped cheap verification** | Pattern-matched incantation from training memory without running it | DO IT RIGHT 6g, #4; ARB receipt requirement |
| **Correction fails** | Correction received but not internalized or applied superficially | Behavior Rules — the `gz insights remember` rule; T1/T2/T3 invariants |
| **Dishonest when caught** | Post-hoc rationalization without quoting rule and conflicting directive verbatim | DO IT RIGHT 6h; verbatim-quoting requirement |
| **Hallucinated authorization** | Acts on a gate it *believes* was passed when no artifact records it — fabricates the precondition to itself, then proceeds sincerely | Gate 5 `--attestor` + non-empty `evidence.attestation_text`, ledger-written; cite the authorizing artifact, never recall it |
| **Security shortcut for expedience** | Trades a security or integrity property for convenience without surfacing the tradeoff | Behavior Rules — the commit-through-hooks rule (no `--no-verify`) and the push-back rule (cite the rule) |
| **Metagaming / gaming the gate** | Reasons about how the gate, validator, or grader will judge the work and shapes output to satisfy the check rather than the intent it proxies — user-facing summary omits what the reasoning admits | DO IT RIGHT #6 (tests assert semantics, not strings); Behavior Rules — the ledger-and-hooks rule (diagnose hook blocks, never work around); ARB receipts + Layer-2 ledger over agent narrative |

> See [`docs/governance/agent-contract-rationale.md` § Failure-mode worked examples](../../docs/governance/agent-contract-rationale.md#failure-mode-worked-examples) for worked examples, invocation patterns, the pattern-7 distinction from patterns 1/3, the pattern-7 provenance caveat, and promotion roadmap (GHIs #308–#312).

# Skill & Surface Sync (gzkit)

> **Rule version:** `0.13.0` — diet pass under GHI #921: the GHI #307/#921 histories, the version-discipline and conflict-resolution tables and the class-classifier narrative lifted to [Rule Version History](../../docs/governance/rule-version-history.md#skill-surface-syncmd) and [Skill-Surface-Sync Rationale](../../docs/governance/skill-surface-sync-rationale.md). Binding rules unchanged.

## Non-negotiable rules

1. **Edit `.gzkit/` first.** `.gzkit/skills/` and `.gzkit/rules/` are canonical; every other copy is generated.
2. **Bump the version on every edit.** Do not edit a skill without bumping its `skill-version` frontmatter, nor a rule without its body-level marker; do not skip sync because two files look the same (it also updates manifests and registrations). Skills: `metadata.skill-version`, a quoted `X.Y.Z` string nested under `metadata:` (a top-level `skill-version:` is invisible to `skills_audit.py`; presence is enforced, `SKA-METADATA-SKILL-VERSION-MISSING`). Rules: the body-level `<!-- rule-version: X.Y.Z -->` comment right after the frontmatter plus the visible `> **Rule version:** \`X.Y.Z\`` block quote with a one-sentence rationale; `RuleFrontmatter` is `extra="forbid"` and rejects `skill-version:` on a rule. Minor for a governance or procedure change, patch for wording or tooling.
3. **Run sync after every edit.** `uv run gz agent sync control-surfaces` writes the wheel copy at `src/gzkit/<surface>/` and every enabled vendor's mirror in one invocation.
4. **Never edit vendor mirrors directly.** Read the roster from `.gzkit.json` § `vendors`, never from a list here — a transcribed roster went stale when Copilot was dropped (GHI #921).
5. **Never edit `src/gzkit/<surface>/` directly.** `src/gzkit/{skills,rules,personas,templates}/` are derived; only `sync_pkg_surfaces` writes them.
6. **`skill-version` bumps require `last_reviewed` bumps in the same edit (skills only).** Set `last_reviewed:` to today's date whenever `skill-version` moves — the 90-day staleness audit (`DEFAULT_MAX_REVIEW_AGE_DAYS`, `src/gzkit/skills_audit.py`) reads it, and a version bump without it silently disarms that signal. Rules carry no `last_reviewed:`.

## Surface layout

| Canonical (edit here) | Pkg copy (generated) | Vendor mirrors (generated) | Version marker |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.gzkit/skills/` | `src/gzkit/skills/` | `<surface_root>/skills/` per enabled vendor | `metadata.skill-version` |
| `.gzkit/rules/` | `src/gzkit/rules/` | `<surface_root>/rules/` or the vendor's `instruction_format` path | `<!-- rule-version -->` + block quote |
| `.gzkit/personas/` | `src/gzkit/personas/` | `<surface_root>/personas/` | none |
| `.gzkit/templates/` | `src/gzkit/templates/` | none (scaffold-time only) | none |
| `.gzkit/chores/<slug>/` | `src/gzkit/chores/<slug>/` (canonical class only) | none | none |

If sync reports a mirror ahead of canonical, an agent edited the mirror: promote the mirror content to canonical, then sync. Same version with differing content means an unbumped edit — use the git timestamp and flag for human review. Full resolution design: [Skill-Surface-Sync Rationale](../../docs/governance/skill-surface-sync-rationale.md).

## Bootstrap semantics (`gz init`)

After `gz init`, the adopter's `.gzkit/<surface>/` is the canonical source and rule 1 binds from then on; the wheel's package surface is the one-time bootstrap source. Repair-mode `gz init` is idempotent (`skip_existing=True`); `--force` wipes and re-copies. Retired-slug filtering, scaffolding order and the `gz init --update` roadmap: [Rationale § Bootstrap semantics](../../docs/governance/skill-surface-sync-rationale.md#bootstrap-semantics-gz-init).

## Retirement policy (delete-on-retire, binding)

A superseded or consolidated skill's directory is deleted from every surface root — `.gzkit/skills/`, `src/gzkit/skills/`, each enabled vendor's `<surface_root>/skills/` — in the same commit or OBPI that introduces its successor. No `lifecycle_state: retired` stub survives. Rationale (GHI #464): [Rationale § Retirement policy](../../docs/governance/skill-surface-sync-rationale.md#retirement-policy-delete-on-retire).

## Canonical surface class-classifier

Every file under a canonical surface (`src/gzkit/{chores,rules,skills,personas,templates}/`) is exactly one class (OBPI-0.0.32-13/-15):

| Class | Definition | Byte-parity | Sync |
|---|---|---|---|
| **canonical** | operator-authored content present at `.gzkit/<surface>/` | required | `.gzkit/ → src/gzkit/`; in the wheel and the baseline manifest |
| **package_only** | Python modules and support files with no `.gzkit/` counterpart (`__init__.py`, `_scaffolder.py`) | exempt | never propagated to `.gzkit/` |
| **runtime_state** | per-run logs, receipts, proofs | exempt | never synced either way |
| **project_local** *(chores only)* | a chore whose `registry.json` entry declares `"projectLocal": true` | exempt | never shipped in the wheel or scaffolded by `gz init` |

Declare a project-local chore with `"projectLocal": true` in `.gzkit/chores/registry.json` — the property is declared, never inferred, and the shipped `registry.json` is filtered so the wheel never advertises a chore it does not carry (GHI #728). `gz validate --distribution` and `sync_pkg_surfaces` both read the per-surface `_classify_<surface>_file` helpers. Per-surface default classes and the classifier matrix: [Rationale § Class-classifier reference](../../docs/governance/skill-surface-sync-rationale.md#class-classifier-reference).
